summary.zh: 把公司架构、流程与岗位写成可版本管理的文档
summary.en: Document your whole company as version-controlled markdown

description.zh: 通过 12 个阶段的访谈，把公司的组织结构、流程和岗位职责写成可版本管理的 Markdown 文档，形成团队和 AI 都能读的公司手册。适合希望沉淀一份随业务演进持续更新的内部知识库时使用。需要本地 Python 环境运行脚手架和校验脚本。
description.en: Runs a 12-phase interview and turns company structure, processes and roles into version-controlled markdown that teammates and AI agents can read. Use it to build a handbook that evolves with the business. Needs Python locally.
